title: DepthsOfDepravity
description: A Ancient Species Lurks In You're World Watching You
body:
Depths of Depravity introduces a mysterious and terrifying new entity that haunts every corner of your Minecraft world. This ancient being doesn’t obey normal spawning rules it can appear anywhere, at any time, watching from the shadows as you mine, build, or explore. Its presence is rare, but unmistakable the moment you sense it, you’ll know you’re being hunted.

The Species motives are unknown. Some say They Were guardians of a forgotten civilization; others believe they are the darkness itself, drawn to those who linger too long in the depths. When it finds you, escape is nearly impossible. You’ll either survive the night—or become another whisper in the silence it leaves behind.

Do you have what it takes to face what watches from the dark?
